archetypes.name: score-signal
archetypes.rationale: The change defines a scoring-derived allocation signal that must match live scoreboard semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether net-score-per-finding is defined consistently with the existing scoring tables and scoreboard columns. Check that OOS accepted, rejected, and proposed counts cannot enter the future allocation signal. Confirm that current point scoring behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-boundary
archetypes.rationale: This docs-only change must preserve the planned file boundary and avoid accidental policy expansion.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the modified docs for scope discipline. Check that the prose does not imply token allocation ships now, does not choose raw acceptance rate, and does not change current reviewer scoring or pruning semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
